// Complete independently authored neutral models.
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use ir::{Instance, SchemaNode, ScalarType, Value};
use mapping::{FormatOptions, Graph, Node, Project, Scope, ScopeConstruction};

pub fn scalar(case: &serde_json::Value) -> Value {
    let value = &case["expected_scalar"];
    match value["kind"].as_str().expect("literal kind") {
        "String" => Value::String(value["value"].as_str().expect("literal text").into()),
        "Bool" => Value::Bool(value["value"].as_bool().expect("literal boolean")),
        "Int" => Value::Int(value["value"].as_i64().expect("literal signed integer")),
        "Float" => Value::Float(f64::from_bits(u64::from_str_radix(value["bits"].as_str().expect("literal bits"), 16).expect("literal binary64"))),
        _ => panic!("unqualified literal kind"),
    }
}
pub fn xml_scalar(name: &str, ty: ScalarType) -> SchemaNode {
    SchemaNode::scalar(name, ty)
}
pub fn source_schema() -> SchemaNode {
    SchemaNode::group("Input", vec![
        xml_scalar("Text", ScalarType::String), xml_scalar("Flag", ScalarType::Bool),
        xml_scalar("Count", ScalarType::Int), xml_scalar("Measure", ScalarType::Float),
    ])
}
pub fn source_instance() -> Instance {
    Instance::Group(vec![
        ("Text".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::String("birch & Ω".into()))),
        ("Flag".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::Bool(true))),
        ("Count".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::Int(-7))),
        ("Measure".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::Float(f64::from_bits(0x3ff4000000000000)))),
    ].into())
}
pub fn hinted(location: &str) -> FormatOptions {
    FormatOptions {
        xml_document: true,
        xml_schema_hints: Some(ir::XmlSchemaHints { no_namespace_location: Some(location.into()), derivation: Some(ir::XmlSchemaHintDerivation { schema_reference: location.into() }), ..Default::default() }),
        ..FormatOptions::default()
    }
}
pub fn expected_project(case: &serde_json::Value) -> Project {
    let ty = match case["type"].as_str().expect("literal type") {
        "String" => ScalarType::String, "Bool" => ScalarType::Bool,
        "Int" => ScalarType::Int, "Float" => ScalarType::Float,
        _ => panic!("unqualified type"),
    };
    let feed = case["feed"].as_u64().expect("literal feed");
    let node = match feed {
        80 => Node::Const { value: scalar(case) },
        10..=13 => Node::SourceField { path: vec![match feed { 10 => "Text", 11 => "Flag", 12 => "Count", 13 => "Measure", _ => unreachable!() }.into()], frame: None },
        _ => panic!("unqualified feed"),
    };
    // Import derives the output schema-location hint from the target schema.
    let target_schema = match case["name"].as_str() {
        Some("target-explicit-one") => "cardinality-target-explicit-one.xsd".to_owned(),
        _ => format!("target-{}.xsd", case["type"].as_str().expect("literal type")),
    };
    Project {
        source: source_schema(), target: xml_scalar("Output", ty),
        source_path: Some("input.xml".into()), target_path: Some("output.xml".into()),
        source_options: FormatOptions { xml_document: true, ..FormatOptions::default() },
        target_options: hinted(&target_schema),
        extra_sources: vec![], extra_targets: vec![], failure_rules: vec![], user_functions: BTreeMap::new(),
        graph: Graph { nodes: BTreeMap::from([(0, node)]) },
        root: Scope { construction: ScopeConstruction::Scalar { value: 0 }, ..Scope::default() },
    }
}

pub fn expected_named_project() -> Project {
    let mut project = Project {
        source: source_schema(), target: xml_scalar("Output", ScalarType::String),
        source_path: Some("input.xml".into()), target_path: Some("output.xml".into()),
        source_options: FormatOptions { xml_document: true, ..FormatOptions::default() },
        target_options: hinted("target-String.xsd"),
        extra_sources: vec![], extra_targets: vec![mapping::NamedTarget {
            name: "Audit".into(), path: Some("audit.xml".into()),
            schema: xml_scalar("Output", ScalarType::String),
            options: hinted("target-String.xsd"),
            root: Scope { construction: ScopeConstruction::Scalar { value: 0 }, ..Scope::default() },
        }], failure_rules: vec![], user_functions: BTreeMap::new(),
        graph: Graph { nodes: BTreeMap::from([(0, Node::SourceField { path: vec!["Text".into()], frame: None })]) },
        root: Scope { construction: ScopeConstruction::Scalar { value: 0 }, ..Scope::default() },
    };
    // This complete model uses literal metadata, never imported metadata.
    project.extra_targets.shrink_to_fit();
    project
}
